description: Propose an architectural task or a by-design mark for the user to approve; nothing changes until they do (harness ui, Work › Inbox), so tell them. kind 'task': from a finding (finding = its key from architecture_findings) or from your own observation (no finding; title, reason = what should change and why, evidence = the places that show it; it is recorded as your interpretation, apart from harness's findings). kind 'by_design': a finding (key) and reason = why it is intended. scope workspace for a finding between services. Never add architectural tasks to a backlog file or create them yourself: this rule is steered by the tools and instructions, not enforced. Other tasks keep the usual flow.

finding.description: the finding's key (from architecture_findings); required for by_design, empty for a task from your own observation

scope.description: project (default) or workspace: a finding between the services of this project's workspaces

reason.description: task: what should change and why; by_design: why it is intended

evidence.description: own observation: the places that show it (path:line)

name: architecture_propose
